title: MAE VisualGroundingBlock
description: Structured creative grounding for Generated-Scene visuals (S5/Media). A visual is never produced from a generic prompt; it inherits the angle's specificity. Extended 2026-09-12 (backward-compatible): optional id/class/subject/emotional_tone/provenance/detail_classes. detail_classes keeps SOURCE-GROUNDED visual detail distinct from PRODUCTION INSTRUCTION — a production interpretation must never masquerade as Customer Truth.

detail_classes.description: field -> evidence class of that visual detail. source_grounded = traceable to Customer/Product/Brand Truth. production_instruction = a rendering interpretation derived from grounded facts (e.g. night scene -> low-key practical lighting).

provenance.description: Real provenance back to Truth records. Never a synthetic brief-derived id.
